title: Check if Numbers Are Ascending in a Sentence
summary: A sentence consists of tokens separated by a single space, with no leading or trailing spaces.
statement: A sentence consists of tokens separated by a single space, with no leading or trailing spaces. Tokens are either positive numbers (digits 0-9 with no leading zeros) or words (lowercase English letters). Given a string s representing a sentence, determine if all numbers are strictly increasing from left to right. Return true if they are, otherwise return false.
constraints: The sentence has single-space-separated word or positive-integer tokens with no leading zeros.
Read numeric tokens from left to right while ignoring words.
Return whether every number is strictly greater than the preceding number.
hints: Only numeric tokens participate, but their order in the sentence must be preserved.
Split on spaces, convert digit-only tokens, and compare each with the last number.
Initialize previous below all valid values; reject value<=previous; otherwise assign previous=value.
Each numeric token is compared with its immediate numeric predecessor, whose strict increase inductively guarantees the entire sequence is increasing.
editorial: Each numeric token is compared with its immediate numeric predecessor, whose strict increase inductively guarantees the entire sequence is increasing.

arguments: 1 box has 3 blue 4 red 6 green and 12 yellow marbles

tests.explanation: The repeated value five violates strict increase.
